description: Anne Santoro is running for state Representative in the 37th District representing East Lyme, Montville and Salem. Anne is a graduate of Stanford University and UConn School of Law. She is an attorney that has practiced municipal and business law along with an exemplary public service record serving East Lyme as our Deputy First Selectman, the Board of Finance, Chairperson of the ARPA Subcommittee and more.
